step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated data validation scripts and manual spot checks.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Inaccurate data entry leading to flawed analysis.

subprocess_flow.purpose: To provide a visual and data-driven foundation for performance assessment.
success_criteria: Dashboard reflects 100% of the required metrics for the reporting period.
subprocess_flow.end_conditions: KPI Dashboard is fully updated with the latest period data.
subprocess_flow.description: Gather and consolidate data for the key performance indicators including Stock-out Rate (M-001), Average Time to Replenish (M-002), and Save-the-Sale Conversion Rate (M-003). This sub-step involves updating the centralized monitoring dashboard to reflect the current period's performance against historical benchmarks.

subprocess_flow.purpose: To correlate performance metrics with operational root causes.
subprocess_flow.substep_name: Analyze Performance Trends and Root Causes
subprocess_flow.scope: Trend analysis and root cause correlation.
subprocess_flow.description: Analyze the updated KPI data in conjunction with the Root Cause Analysis and Documentation from the preceding process step. Identify specific trends, such as recurring vendor delays or specific product categories with high stock-out rates, to understand the 'why' behind the numbers.
success_criteria: Correlation identified between at least 80% of major stock-out events and their root causes.

step_risks_and_controls.control: Cross-referencing KPI trends with qualitative incident reports.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Misinterpretation of data without operational context.

subprocess_flow.end_conditions: Analysis of performance drivers is documented.

dependencies: Analyze Performance Trends and Root Causes

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Omission of critical performance failures in the summary.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Peer review of the summary for clarity and accuracy.

subprocess_flow.end_conditions: Performance Review Summary is drafted and ready for distribution.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To prepare a concise summary of performance for stakeholder review.
success_criteria: Summary document completed and distributed to stakeholders 24 hours before the review meeting.
subprocess_flow.description: Synthesize the data and analysis into a comprehensive Performance Review Summary. This document serves as the primary briefing material for stakeholders, highlighting critical successes in customer mitigation and identifying persistent bottlenecks in the replenishment cycle.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Lack of stakeholder engagement or biased feedback.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Structured agenda and independent facilitator if necessary.

subprocess_flow.description: Convene a meeting with relevant stakeholders (department heads, supply chain leads, and the Inventory Control Manager) to discuss the findings. The goal is to validate the analysis, gather frontline insights on the effectiveness of stock-out responses, and reach a consensus on required adjustments.
success_criteria: Attendance of all key department heads and documented consensus on performance gaps.
subprocess_flow.end_conditions: Review meeting concluded with documented action items.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To ensure organizational alignment and gather qualitative feedback on process efficiency.

triggers: Conclusion of the Stakeholder Review Session.
subprocess_flow.end_conditions: Process Improvement Plan is finalized and signed off by the Store Manager.

step_risks_and_controls.control: Feasibility study and cost-benefit analysis of proposed changes.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Proposing improvements that are not operationally or financially viable.

subprocess_flow.purpose: To translate performance data into actionable strategic improvements.
subprocess_flow.description: Based on the data analysis and stakeholder feedback, develop a formal Process Improvement Plan. This plan should detail specific strategic adjustments to inventory investment, warehouse operational changes, or training for customer-facing staff to improve 'Save-the-Sale' conversion rates.
success_criteria: Plan includes at least three actionable improvements with assigned owners and deadlines.

subprocess_flow.purpose: To provide senior management with the data needed for informed supply chain strategy decisions.
triggers: Finalization of the Process Improvement Plan.
subprocess_flow.description: Present the finalized Performance Review Summary and the Process Improvement Plan to senior management. This ensures that leadership is informed of supply chain performance and provides the necessary authorization for any significant resource allocations or strategic shifts.
success_criteria: Formal acknowledgment or approval of the Improvement Plan by senior leadership.

step_risks_and_controls.control: Executive summary highlighting ROI and strategic alignment.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Senior management misalignment with proposed operational changes.

subprocess_flow.end_conditions: Performance review completed and shared with stakeholders/senior management.
